Now I see the issue! In `tls_process_ske_dhe`, when `EVP_PKEY_assign_DH(peer_tmp, dh)` succeeds, the DH object `dh` is now owned by `peer_tmp`. But if later the security check fails (`ssl_security`), the code goes to `err:` which calls both `DH_free(dh)` and `EVP_PKEY_free(peer_tmp)`. Since `peer_tmp` still owns `dh` (via `EVP_PKEY_assign_DH`), calling `DH_free(dh)` will free it, and then `EVP_PKEY_free(peer_tmp)` will try to free it again via `evp_pkey_free_it` -> `pkey_free` -> `DH_free`.
